Strategy: Rank leftovers in four tiers. Exact fits first, then leftovers holding one more item, then roomier leftovers, and dead leftovers only when every placement kills a bin. Score with tier gaps so no lower tier beats a higher one, so ranking can switch from Best Fit when it would take a dead or roomy leftover over a one-more band. It may help by keeping bins usable, but may fail by passing up fills for bins later items never need.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    mx = max(bins)
    return [0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) + item if item <= r - item < item * 2 else (-(r - item) if r - item >= item * 2 else -(r - item) - mx)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Four-tier lexicographic: exact > one-more band > roomy > dead.
